```{r}
library(gofgamma)
library(goft)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
```


```{r}

estimer <- function(liste_obs) {
  n <- length(liste_obs)
  Y_list <- vector("list", n)
  s_list <- vector("list", n)
  for (i in 1:n) {
    t_i <- liste_obs[[i]]$t
    X_i <- liste_obs[[i]]$X
    Y_list[[i]] <- diff(X_i)   
    s_list[[i]] <- diff(t_i)   
  }
  Y_all <- unlist(Y_list)
  s_all <- unlist(s_list)
  N <- length(Y_all)
  mu_hat     <- sum(Y_all / s_all) / N
  sigma2_hat <- sum((Y_all - s_all * mu_hat)^2 / s_all) / N
  a_hat <- mu_hat^2 / sigma2_hat
  b_hat <- sigma2_hat / mu_hat
  list(a = a_hat, b = b_hat, mu = mu_hat, sigma2 = sigma2_hat, N = N)
}
```


```{r}
pgcd <- function(a, b) {
  a <- abs(a); b <- abs(b)
  while (b != 0) {
    temp <- b
    b <- a %% b
    a <- temp
  }
  return(a)
}
```


```{r}
construire_grille <- function(liste_obs, digits = 1) {
  t_obs <- unlist(lapply(liste_obs, function(df) df$t))
  t_obs_round <- round(t_obs, digits)
  t_obs_unique <- sort(unique(t_obs_round))
  facteur <- 10^digits
  t_obs_int <- round(t_obs_unique * facteur)
  differences <- diff(t_obs_int)
  delta_int <- differences[1]
  if (length(differences) > 1) {
    for (i in 2:length(differences)) delta_int <- pgcd(delta_int, differences[i])
  }
  pas_fine <- delta_int / facteur
  t_max <- max(t_obs_unique)
  t_fine <- seq(0, t_max, by = pas_fine)
  m_i <- sapply(liste_obs, function(df) nrow(df) - 1)
  n <- length(liste_obs)
  m_bar <- sum(m_i) / n
  list(t_star = t_obs_unique, m_star = length(t_obs_unique), m_bar = m_bar,
       grille = t_fine, h_star = pas_fine, delta = pas_fine)
}
```


```{r}
pont_gamma_une_traj <- function(obs, grille, a) {
  t <- obs$t; X <- obs$X
  t_max_i <- max(t)
  t_star <- grille[grille <= t_max_i]
  n_star <- length(t_star) - 1
  Y <- numeric(length(t_star))
  Y[1] <- 0
  if (n_star > 1) {
    for (i in 2:n_star) {
      inter <- max(t[t <= t_star[i]])
      if (inter > t_star[i - 1]) {
        t_inf <- inter; x_inf <- X[t == inter]
      } else {
        t_inf <- t_star[i - 1]; x_inf <- Y[i - 1]
      }
      t_sup <- min(t[t > t_star[i]])
      x_sup <- X[t == t_sup]
      y <- rbeta(1, a * (t_star[i] - t_inf), a * (t_sup - t_star[i]))
      Y[i] <- x_inf + (x_sup - x_inf) * y
    }
  }
  Y[length(t_star)] <- X[length(X)]
  list(t = t_star, new_obs = Y)
}
```

```{r}
pont_gamma_multi <- function(liste_obs, a = NULL, b = NULL, digits = 1) {
  n <- length(liste_obs)
  est <- NULL
  if (is.null(a) || is.null(b)) {
    est <- estimer(liste_obs)
    if (is.null(a)) a <- est$a
    if (is.null(b)) b <- est$b
  }
  grille_info <- construire_grille(liste_obs, digits = digits)
  trajectoires <- vector("list", n)
  for (i in 1:n) {
    trajectoires[[i]] <- pont_gamma_une_traj(liste_obs[[i]], grille_info$grille, a)
  }
  list(a = a, b = b, estimation = est, t_star = grille_info$t_star,
       m_star = grille_info$m_star, m_bar = grille_info$m_bar,
       h_star = grille_info$h_star, grille = grille_info$grille,
       trajectoires = trajectoires)
}
```


```{r}
# Accroissements Delta X_i
construire_Z <- function(res) {
  increments_list <- lapply(res$trajectoires, function(tr) diff(tr$new_obs))
  unlist(increments_list)
}
```

# Application 1

```{r}
simuler_GP_multi <- function(liste_t, A, b) {
  n <- length(liste_t)
  liste_obs <- vector("list", n)
  for (i in 1:n) {
    t_i <- liste_t[[i]]
    forme <- diff(A(t_i))
    increments <- rgamma(length(forme), shape = forme, scale = b)
    X_i <- c(0, cumsum(increments))
    liste_obs[[i]] <- data.frame(t = t_i, X = X_i)
  }
  liste_obs
}
```

## Cas 1

```{r}
set.seed(46)
liste_t <- list(
  c(0, 3, 8),
  c(0, 2, 5, 9, 12),
  c(0, 4, 7, 11, 15, 18, 22, 27, 33, 39, 45),
  c(0, 2, 3, 5, 8, 9, 14, 15, 17, 20, 22, 25, 27, 30,
    33, 46, 58)
)
A_hgp <- function(t) 5 * t
liste_obs <- simuler_GP_multi(liste_t, A = A_hgp, b = 3)
res <- pont_gamma_multi(liste_obs)
Z1 <- construire_Z(res)
par <- estimer(liste_obs)

```

## Visualisation

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=16}

xmax_global <- max(res$grille, sapply(liste_obs, function(df) max(df$t)))
ymax_global <- max(
  sapply(liste_obs, function(df) max(df$X)),
  sapply(res$trajectoires, function(tr) max(tr$new_obs))
)

par(mfrow = c(4, 1))
for (i in seq_along(liste_obs)) {
  t_i <- liste_obs[[i]]$t
  X_i <- liste_obs[[i]]$X
  plot(NULL, xlim = c(0, xmax_global), ylim = c(0, ymax_global),
       xlab = "Temps", ylab = "Degradation X(t)",
       main = paste("Traj.", i))
  lines(res$trajectoires[[i]]$t, res$trajectoires[[i]]$new_obs,
        col = "blue", lwd = 1.5, lty = 2, type = "o", pch = 17, cex = 1.1)
  lines(t_i, X_i, col = "red", lwd = 1.5, type = "o", pch = 16, cex = 1.4)
}
```

# Test d'adéquation 

## Test de HME
```{r}
res_henze <- test.HME1(Z1, a = 1, boot = 200, alpha = 0.05)
res_henze
```

## Test de VGE
```{r}
res_vill <- gamma_test(Z1)
res_vill
```

# Application 2 : Donnée Laser


```{r}
library(SMRD.data)
data("gaaslaser")
```

## Cas 1 : Inspections irrégulières (Fréquence  décroissante)

```{r}
temps_conserves <- c(0, 250, 500, 750, 1000, 1500, 2000, 2500, 3000, 4000)
df_filtre <- gaaslaser[gaaslaser$hours %in% temps_conserves, ]
df_filtre <- df_filtre[order(df_filtre$unit, df_filtre$hours), ]
unites <- sort(unique(df_filtre$unit))
liste_obs <- vector("list", length(unites))
for (i in seq_along(unites)) {
  sous <- df_filtre[df_filtre$unit == unites[i], ]
  liste_obs[[i]] <- data.frame(t = sous$hours, X = sous$increase)
}

```

```{r}
plot(NULL, xlim = range(temps_conserves), ylim = c(0, max(sapply(liste_obs, function(df) max(df$X)))),
     xlab = "Time", ylab = "Performance characteristic")
for (i in seq_along(liste_obs)) {
  lines(liste_obs[[i]]$t, liste_obs[[i]]$X, type = "o", pch = 16, cex = 0.7, lwd = 1)
}
abline(h = 10, lty = 2)
```

## Test d'adéquation

```{r}
set.seed(46)
res <- pont_gamma_multi(liste_obs, digits = 0)
Z3 <- construire_Z(res)

```


```{r}
res_henze_Y <- test.HME1(Z3, a = 1, boot = 100, alpha = 0.05)
print(res_henze_Y)
```


```{r}
res_villasenor_Y <- gamma_test(Z3)
print(res_villasenor_Y)
```

##  Cas 3

```{r}

temps_dec     <- c(0, 250, 500, 750, 1000, 1500, 2000, 2500, 3000, 4000)          
temps_croiss  <- c(0, 1000, 1500, 2000, 2500, 3000, 3250, 3500, 3750, 4000)       

unites <- sort(unique(gaaslaser$unit))
n <- length(unites)

unites_croiss <- unites[1:7]
unites_dec    <- unites[8:15]

liste_obs <- vector("list", n)
idx <- 1

for (u in unites_croiss) {
  sous <- gaaslaser[gaaslaser$unit == u & gaaslaser$hours %in% temps_croiss, ]
  sous <- sous[order(sous$hours), ]
  liste_obs[[idx]] <- data.frame(t = sous$hours, X = sous$increase)
  idx <- idx + 1
}

for (u in unites_dec) {
  sous <- gaaslaser[gaaslaser$unit == u & gaaslaser$hours %in% temps_dec, ]
  sous <- sous[order(sous$hours), ]
  liste_obs[[idx]] <- data.frame(t = sous$hours, X = sous$increase)
  idx <- idx + 1
}
```

# Visualisation 

```{r}
couleurs <- c(rep("steelblue", length(unites_croiss)), rep("firebrick", length(unites_dec)))

plot(NULL, xlim = c(0, max(gaaslaser$hours)), ylim = c(0, max(gaaslaser$increase)),
     xlab = "Temps (heures)", ylab = "Degradation")

for (i in seq_along(liste_obs)) {
  lines(liste_obs[[i]]$t, liste_obs[[i]]$X,
        col = couleurs[i], lwd = 1.3, type = "o", pch = 16, cex = 0.8)
}

```
